records.source: Hey, honey... look, it's you!$h
records.translation: Hoy, mahal... tingnan mo, ikaw iyan!$h

records.source: Are you entering the fishing contest this year, @? My mom's pretty serious about winning.
records.translation: Sasali ka ba sa paligsahan sa pangingisda ngayong taon, @? Talagang determinado si Nanay na manalo.

records.source: Brr... my hands are freezing from making this snowman.$l
records.translation: Brr... Naninigas sa lamig ang mga kamay ko sa paggawa ng taong-niyebe na ito.$l

records.source: Don't worry about me, I never get cold...
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala sa akin, hindi ako kailanman nilalamig...

records.source: Aren't you cold? Are you sure you don't want my jacket?
records.translation: Hindi ka ba nilalamig? Tiyak ka bang ayaw mong hiramin ang dyaket ko?

records.source: What do you think of my snow-goon?
records.translation: Ano sa tingin mo sa halimaw-niyebe ko?

records.source: I'm sorry, but carving ice parapets requires my undivided attention!
records.translation: Paumanhin, pero kailangan kong ituon ang buong pansin ko sa pag-ukit ng mga muog na yelo!

records.source: You know what? I probably should've worn a jacket.
records.translation: Alam mo? Dapat pala nagsuot ako ng dyaket.

records.source: I'm not very creative when it comes to snowmen.$s
records.translation: Hindi ako gaanong malikhain pagdating sa mga taong-niyebe.$s

records.source: Cold? Nah, I never get cold.
records.translation: Nilalamig? Hindi, hindi ako kailanman nilalamig.

records.source: This snow is so cold I can't feel my fingers anymore...$s
records.translation: Napakalamig ng niyebeng ito at hindi ko na maramdaman ang mga daliri ko...$s

records.source: If it was up to me, I'd probably have a pizza festival at the saloon, instead...
records.translation: Kung ako ang masusunod, malamang na magdaraos ako ng pista ng pizza sa Saloon sa halip...

records.source: How's winter coming along for you, @?$h
records.translation: Kumusta ang taglamig mo, @?$h

records.source: Igloo-building's an art I picked up from the tundra dwellers who live beyond the frozen sea.#$e#That was many years ago.$h#$e#An Igloo makes a nice home, but it's easier to just stay in my tent year-round.
records.translation: Isang sining ang paggawa ng igloo na natutuhan ko sa mga naninirahan sa tundra sa kabila ng nagyeyelong dagat.#$e#Napakatagal na niyon.$h#$e#Magandang tahanan ang igloo, pero mas madali pa ring manatili sa tolda ko buong taon.

records.source: Snowmen are okay, I guess. But mostly I'm looking forward to the spring.
records.translation: Ayos lang ang mga taong-niyebe, siguro. Pero higit sa lahat, inaasam ko ang tagsibol.

records.source: Hmmph... Wife dragged me out into the cold for this?
records.translation: Hmph... Kinaladkad ako ni Misis sa lamig para rito?

records.source: Did I ever tell you how George and I first met? He actually pelted me with a snowball in this very festival.#$e#He was a gentleman back then, and came over to see if I was okay.$h
records.translation: Nasabi ko na ba sa iyo kung paano kami unang nagkakilala ni George? Binato niya talaga ako ng niyebeng binilog sa pista ring ito.#$e#Maginoo siya noon at lumapit para tingnan kung ayos lang ako.$h

records.source: Welcome to the Festival of Ice!#$e#The highlight of today's festival is the ice fishing competition. We set up this 'frozen lake' and stocked it full of fish.#$b#Just let me know when you're ready to compete.
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa Pista ng Yelo!#$e#Ang tampok ng pista ngayon ay ang paligsahan sa pangingisda sa yelo. Inihanda namin ang 'nagyeyelong lawa' na ito at pinunô ng mga isda.#$b#Sabihin mo lang kapag handa ka nang makipagpaligsahan.

records.source: Emily started helping me without any provocation... does that mean something? *gulp*$4
records.translation: Sinimulan akong tulungan ni Emily nang hindi ko hinihingi... may ibig sabihin kaya iyon? *lunok*$4
